description: The Romanian court decisions linked to ONE act, as a paged list: the High Court's binding decisions (RIL, HP) first, then the newest, each with its court, kind, number, date, recorded outcome and the articles it cites. Use it for 'what case law is there on this act', which includes the decisions that cite the act as a whole and that get_related (one article) does not list. Read a listed decision with lookup_decision.

binding_only.description: true: only the RIL and HP decisions, which bind every court.

law.description: The act, however it is at hand: a citation ('Legea 85/2014', 'HG 1/2016'), a common name ('Codul muncii', 'CPC'), or a title any tool printed. An act that approves a code ('Legea 134/2010') is read as the code.

limit.description: Decisions on a page, 1-50 (default 20). Keep it the same between pages.

page.description: Page, from 1 (default 1). The answer says what to ask for the next one.

name: get_act_case_law
